test_method: Minimal API stand-in, not installed Streamlit or a browser
checks: Offline demo produces four metric calls and three plotted columns.
Pause retains the previous view and disables the fragment interval.
Read once now refreshes the view while paused.
Malformed JSON preserves the old view with a warning.
Switching files clears data from the previous source.
Curve toggles alter plot selection without recalculating statistics.
